parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Court-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 16.8 | 2.56 | 2.56
2 | 73.3 | 10.4 | 12.9
3 | 701 | 49.9 | 62.9
4 | 51.6 | 51.4 | 114
5 | 99.8 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Court-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: AKH type
Aquifer depth: 62.9 – 114 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately resistive (51.6 Ω·m) saturated sand/gravel horizon between 62.9 m and 114 m as the primary aquifer zone; case off the overlying highly resistive (701 Ω·m) layer to prevent borehole collapse during drilling, and log carefully as the drill approaches 114 m in case the underlying 99.8 Ω·m layer offers a secondary water-bearing zone.
